precepts.label: Isaiah 37:21-38
precepts.why:
Pride destroyed every kingdom on the earth, and Assyria is the first king in line. Sennacherib took all the defenced cities of Judah, then sent Rabshakeh, his herald, with big words: “What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?” When Hezekiah's men begged him to speak in the Syrian language so the people on the wall would not hear, he said he was sent to “the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you.” Then he mocked the Lord himself: “Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?” … “that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?” All that pride came out of the king of Assyria's mouth by way of his messenger.

God heard all that smack. “Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria: This is the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.” She is laughing at this man's tough talk, the way a parent shakes their head when they told you not to do it and are about to whoop your ass. You are not going to one-up God, and that goes for everyone making videos mocking God's prophets. God will one-up you.

“For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake. Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand.” One of God's angels destroyed 185,000. The sun went down and they were all alive; at the crack of the morning, “they were all dead corpses.” Talking prideful against God, everybody had to die.

But God was hunting Sennacherib himself. “So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.” He thought he got away. Then “as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god”, his own sons “smote him with the sword”, and they escaped into Armenia, and his other son Esarhaddon reigned in his stead and didn't even care.

Pride destroyed the king of Assyria, as “a man’s pride shall bring him low” in Proverbs 29. And it is the same line through every kingdom after him, Babylon, the Greeks, Rome and America: none is exempt from pride, and none is exempt from God destroying them for it.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 30:16
precepts.why:
Isaiah calls Israel “a people robbed and spoiled.” We are robbed of our nationality, robbed of the understanding that we are the twelve tribes of the children of Israel. Jeremiah shows how we are spoiled, and what the Lord will do about it.

“Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured”: that is going to take place upon the oppressors of our people. “and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity”: the adversaries are all the nations outside of the children of Israel, and every one of the nations that oppress us shall go into captivity.

How do they spoil us? Over a multitude of captivities the children of Israel have gone into, every single nation has had its hand in the oppression of the twelve tribes. That includes the Arabs, that a lot of brothers and sisters want to cry over when they see what is going on in Palestine. Those people had our people oppressed too; they were spoiling the hell out of us. What we are seeing overseas right now is the righteous judgment of the Lord, prophecy fulfilling right now.

Yet brothers and sisters are so damn fearful to escape this captivity and get themselves together, even as the prophecies come to pass. Many are called, but few are chosen, so self-examine. With bombs dropping and rumors of war, men are still catting around, committing fornication, letting their wives rule over them and hide their folly, paying for prostitutes, hooked on marijuana and controlled by the porn system. Our people are sick; they are afraid of freedom, because sin controls them.

“and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.” The nations that spoiled us shall in turn be a spoil for us, because the tables are turned. We serve a just God. So Isaiah’s people “for a prey” and “for a spoil” will not stay that way: those that prey upon Israel are given for a prey themselves.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:1
thread.text: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

classes.title: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.label: Psalms 137:7
precepts.why:
Who is the virgin daughter of Babylon? Let's identify her. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Destroy it, destroy it. Then, speaking to the same people: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. Edom is now called the daughter of Babylon, and she is destined to be destroyed.

So Isaiah 47 is the destruction of Babylon, which is Edom, the very thing David said in the psalm. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground”: you have been taken down, defeated. Then “there is no throne”: your throne is finished, your throne is over.

Then, “for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” Babylon calls herself tender and delicate. How? The United States of America says, we are a Christian nation. She has two horns like a lamb, Republicans and Democrats, and says, we are Christian, in God we trust. That is the tender and delicate virgin, and God says she will be called that no more.

The children of Edom who cried to raze Jerusalem to its foundation are the daughter of Babylon today, America, and she is the one who is to be destroyed.

precepts.label: Judges 16:21
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the daughter of Babylon, “Take the millstones, and grind meal”. What does that mean? When you take millstones and grind meal, you are working. But what kind of work? Look at what happened to Samson.

Samson listened to that woman called Delilah, who got paid to take his strength and destroy this mighty black man. She was a black woman, not an Israelite but a Hamite, a good-looking Hamite, and she gave it to him so good that he told her his secrets and went to sleep on her knees. The Philistines came in, cut his hair, bound him up and took his eyes out: “But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.”

When it says they made him grind, they made him work. That is slavery. Even when you go to prison they make you work, and that is still slavery: look up the 13th Amendment.

So this is what God is saying to America, to these Europeans, these Caucasians: take the millstones and grind meal. Get ready for slavery. Then “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” As a tender and delicate virgin her head was covered; God says uncover it, lift the dress to the calf, then to the thigh. The rivers she passes over are the word of God, “the washing of water by the word”. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets open the word of God and show she is not, revealing her wickedness.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:16
precepts.why:
“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” How is America's nakedness uncovered? Through the prophets: the brothers on the streets, on YouTube, traveling, must uncover America's nakedness and reveal her wickedness. And Christ is not coming back as a man; he is coming back as God, because only a God can take down the United States of America. Russia can't do it, China can't do it. America has bases all over the world, and no other nation has that power.

Revelation 17 shows what happens to America and her allies: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” The ten horns on the beast with seven heads are NATO, the EU. They shall hate America, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire. That is the United States of America burnt up and destroyed.

Is America finished then? The party ain't over. 2 Esdras 15 says, “And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” Not all of her is destroyed in that war. The country as we know it is finished, but America is not down yet, with all those bases everywhere.

That is why Isaiah says “I will not meet thee as a man.” The ten horns can make her naked and burn her, but the only one that can finally destroy America is God, Christ when he returns.

precepts.label: Romans 9:17
precepts.why:
The only one that can destroy America is Christ when he returns, and Romans 9 shows why God raised her up at all: “For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.”

Pharaoh was over Egypt, and Egypt has long been destroyed. Pharaoh is a metaphor for Rome, and a metaphor for America today. Revelation calls the great city spiritually Sodom and Egypt, and that is Pharaoh right there.

God raised America up. Why? That he might show his power in her. All the technological advances America has, God allowed her to have. There is no nation, no country, that can match Babylon the Great; that is why they call it the great: it has the greatest technology of all nations. Christ says, I must show my power in you, because I am the only one that can take America out.

Then “and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” When Christ finally takes them down, his name shall be declared throughout all the earth, because we are going to declare his real name, his true name. That is the vengeance of Isaiah 47: “I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

thread.label: Isaiah 47:6
thread.text: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

classes.title: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
“I was wroth with my people”: wroth means angry. The pictures of our people in slavery, beaten, on the slave ships, lynched, murdered from the time of slavery all the way up to now, are God being wroth with his people. It is like a family album of our family. He allowed the white man to beat the hell out of us, and we were made slaves for the white man.

Deuteronomy 28:48 is what that anger looked like: “he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Think about the mindset of the brother in those conditions, with the big yoke of iron on his neck and in the different positions of slavery. Your mind is going to go crazy, because you know you are not supposed to be in that situation. That is what those torture devices were set to do.

“until he have destroyed thee” means until your mind breaks down, until your manhood is gone and your ability to be free is gone. When you just succumb to being a slave, your mental strength and fortitude to be independent is broken. That is what black people are today.

So Isaiah 47:6 says the same: “thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” This Christian nation, as they say, showed us no mercy, and laid the yoke heavy even on the oldest among us. And she said “I shall be a lady for ever”, I will be Christian forever, and did not lay these things to heart, “neither didst remember the latter end of it”, though they have the Bible and know what it says will happen at the latter end.

precepts.label: Colossians 2:8
precepts.why:
“I have polluted mine inheritance.” How did God pollute his people? With man-made religions. Paul warns: “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” None of these religions are after Christ.

Look at where they came from. Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, and after the popes the Protestants. John Smith created the Baptist religion. Joseph Smith created the Mormon religion in 1830. Ellen G. White created the Seventh-day Adventist religion in 1863. Charles T. Russell created the Jehovah's Witness religion in 1872. Charles Parham created the Pentecostal religion in 1901.

These run from slavery up to 1863, when we so-called got emancipated, and on through Jim Crow and segregation. The same people who held us as slaves handed us these religions. What happened to John 3:16 and Galatians 3:28 while our people were in chains? They took that out of the Bible at that time.

So Isaiah 47:6 shows God allowed us to be polluted: “I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand.” The traditions of men that spoiled our people are part of that pollution, and that is why Christ is the enemy of Christianity.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:8
thread.text: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

classes.title: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.label: Nahum 3:4
precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly.” Given to pleasures: Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous, champagne wishes and caviar dreams, and it made negroes jealous and envious. “that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Only the Most High can say I am; they are setting themselves up as God on earth. “I shall not sit as a widow”: I will always have my allies. “neither shall I know the loss of children”: my citizens will not die. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: their citizens put to death, and their allies cutting them loose, “for the multitude of thy sorceries.” Their science and technology, like the mystery weapon that left Venezuelan soldiers bleeding through the nose, God calls witchcraft.

Nahum names her: “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” The well-favoured harlot is the same whore of Revelation 17, America, the same virgin daughter of Babylon. She is well-favoured because this is Babylon the great: everybody wants to come here; everybody says, I can get rich there.

She is called the mistress of witchcrafts. And in case you did not think it was America: “that selleth nations.” What nations did America sell? The nation of Judah and the nation of Israel, the two kingdoms, sold into slavery. “and families through her witchcrafts”: did they not sell our families? You had better believe they did.

So the one given to pleasures who says I am, and none else beside me, is the harlot of Nahum. Her sorceries, labored in “from thy youth” since July 4th, 1776, are the reason the loss of children and widowhood will come upon her in one day.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:12
thread.text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

classes.title: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:7
precepts.why:
“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is saying, Stand still and use your science, your sorcery, your technology. “Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee”: their generals, admirals and scientists who examine the stars, set up the golden dome and create this missile and that missile. “Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”: burnt up, destroyed, by nuclear fire, by God’s fire. “there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it”: no comfort for Babylon.

Peter shows that fire: “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” This heaven and this earth are reserved unto fire, and the perdition of ungodly men is Christianity and whatever other little religions are here.

The scoffers say, “Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” They purposely ignore the flood of Genesis 6, when God killed everybody on the planet except eight people: “For this they willingly are ignorant of.” That world perished because of the evils of Cain and his seed.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.” The beloved is Israel: he “hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” It has been over three thousand years since the flood, and they say it will never happen again. But “the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, “and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” That is the destiny of America and all nations.

“what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: our conversation must change. We see the signs, rivers dried up, presidents being stolen. We look for new heavens and a new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness, the twelve tribes of Israel under Christ, and we must be found of him in peace, without spot and blameless.

That church, with its statues all over the place that the people bow down to, is the church of the dead, because they worship the dead. They pray to dead men and graven images, the dumb idols Habakkuk calls a teacher of lies, and the God of Israel is not in that.

It is the same church that enslaved us and built its house by unrighteousness, the house Jeremiah pronounces woe upon: “Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong”. thread.label: Jeremiah 23:1-15
thread.text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.

classes.title: Edom's Achilles' Heel

precepts.label: Matthew 15:24
precepts.why:
“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.” These pastors are wicked as hell. They are about nothing but money; they support wickedness, the fake Israelis and the falsehood called democracy. But the question is: who are the sheep of God's pasture?

Christ answers it: “I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” The sheep is the house of Israel. The sheep are not all nations on the planet: not the white man, not the Arab man, not the Chinese man. The only sheep are the twelve tribes of Israel.

So when you hear pastors say God is gathering his sheep and they are talking about Baptists, Catholics, Episcopalians and Anglicans, they have it all wrong. The pastors have destroyed and scattered the sheep, which is the house of Israel. “Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away”: some pastors are Baptist and take one group of our people, some are African Methodist Episcopal and take another group, some are Catholic and take another. That is how they scatter God's flock and drive them away from the knowledge of the one true God, and God says, “behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings”.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 3:15
precepts.why:
God says, “And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them”. The flock has been scattered in all countries since the time of slavery: from the Assyrians, Babylonians, Persians and Medes, Greeks and Romans, to Spain, France, England and now America. God drove them there, and he will “bring them again to their folds”, their tribes, “and they shall be fruitful and increase.”

“And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them”. Feed them what? Grits and honey? Pork chops and chitlins? No. Jeremiah 3:15 tells what they will be fed: “And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.”

That is the difference between the pastors of Jeremiah 23 who scatter and the shepherds God sets up. The shepherds feed the people with knowledge and understanding, and then “they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.”

precepts.label: Malachi 2:7
precepts.why:
The shepherds God sets up feed his people “with knowledge and understanding.” Knowledge and understanding of what? Malachi breaks it down: “For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.”

There is that word knowledge again, and it is joined to the law. God's knowledge is his law. So the shepherds of Jeremiah 23:4 feed the flock with God's laws.

That is exactly what the pastors of today do not do. They teach that the law is done away with, and so both prophet and priest are profane: treating what is holy as common and unclean, defiling and polluting God's name, his Sabbath and his sanctuary. The true shepherd's lips keep the law, and the people seek it at his mouth.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:9-10
precepts.why:

precepts.why:

That is the “be not cut off in her iniquity” of Jeremiah 51:6: be not cut off, be not destroyed when the chaff goes through. “for this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance”, and we are in that time now. He is slapping the heads of these leaders, making them look stupid and crazy, in our presence.

precepts.label: Zechariah 12:7
precepts.why:
Nebuchadnezzar told Ashpenaz to bring “certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes; Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science”. That is what Deacon Malachi was talking about: Babylon didn't take any old body. Esau did the same thing. They said no, we need the best ones, and put them in North America. The ones they left behind were not the same, and that is why you see Africa the way it is.

The hearings they read say it: within the Negro population of the United States, the Negro working class is destined to be the vanguard of all liberation movements, and a strong Negro movement in the USA will be able to influence and direct the Negro movement in all those backward parts of the world. See what they called all the other places: backward parts of the earth. That is why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks. Canada and Europe have free healthcare and America does not, because they don't want the American blacks to get it; this group here is more dangerous than all the other groups.

That is why the Lord said: “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. That is what the white man knows. It isn't Judah over in Africa; it isn't Judah in Saudi Arabia. It's Judah here, and the Lord is going to raise them up first.

So be proud of this history. Don't be mad; be glad. Sisters, don't just let your boys run out: the white man has his eyes on your sons, because they know what stock they come from. Even if the father was no good, the son is still of good stock, and there is still hope for him.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 33:7
precepts.why:
The hearings said the American Negro is the one who is going to lead all the others, the vanguard of the liberation movement on an international scale. The Bible said it first: “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”.

Judah is going to be the one teaching and preaching, and he is the one who is going to know where the tribes are. “let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

That is why, as in Daniel, the captor chose the best of the children of Israel, the king's seed and the princes, and brought them into the land. Esau took the best stock and put them in North America, and the American Economic Association wrote that the Negro stock landed in America was physically superior to the average of that left behind, the soundest and strongest, who transmitted to their offspring their qualities. We didn't write that; the white man wrote that. Judah in America is the one the Lord brings unto his people and helps from his enemies.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 26:19-21
precepts.why:
Babylon chose children of Israel “in whom was no blemish”, and the white man's own books say the stock landed in America was the soundest and strongest. A lot of our women don't understand this. “My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” Don't give your strength to other nations, or to wicked women.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed”: sow with thine own race. “trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” That's some good stock right there, and some of you are ashamed of it.

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” You didn't know the word race was in the Bible, in terms of ethnicity, in terms of your nationality. This is what your sons and daughters have to know, instead of running around giving their seed to any old thing out there in the world.

And don't hold your breath for reparations. Esau is not stupid. After slavery we had no reparations and still built great, advanced societies without white folks, and they came up with a reason to drop dynamite on us and destroy them, even Seneca Village in Central Park. Trust in the goodness of your stock: we can build without them.

precepts.label: 1 Maccabees 1:1-9
precepts.why:
Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar that after the silver of Persia and Media shall come “another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.” What does it mean that this empire, the Greeks, would bear rule over all the earth? The first book of Maccabees shows it: “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”. Out of Macedon came Philip, and his son Alexander was the one who united those Europeans, all the Edomite nations, together.

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth, And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”. That is what Daniel meant by bearing rule over all the earth. “whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.” This is the beginning of white supremacy in the earth, the beginning of white power: they destroyed the dark nations, and the nations and kings “became tributaries unto him.” Everybody had to pay Alexander and the Greeks tribute.

“And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.” He got sick because of syphilis. He “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”, and after twelve years he died. There were other generals, but the four mightiest were Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Seleucus and Cassander, and they slaughtered the others, like Antigonus, and took his land. Ptolemy took Egypt, Seleucus had Syria, Cassander had Macedonia, and Lysimachus had Thrace and Asia Minor. That is how the empire was divided. “And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.”

Who was Alexander? The Chronology of Ancient Nations (1879) gives the pedigree of Philip, with Greek and Roman gods inserted to make them seem more important, running back through Eliphaz to Esau, Isaac and Abraham. The Rise of Christendom (1890) says King Philip was a descendant of Esau, son of Isaac. The scholars in the know know that Alexander was an Edomite; it is just our people who don't have a clue.

So the brass kingdom of the image is Esau ruling over all the earth, and it runs on into the iron of Rome and the feet of iron and clay, America and NATO, the last empire, still a continuation of Rome. The party isn't over, until the stone strikes the feet.

precepts.label: Ephesians 2:20
precepts.why:
Daniel saw “that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold”. Inquiring minds want to know who this stone is, and Paul answers: “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone”. The chief cornerstone is the leader; that means he is the King. The stone is Christ.

“without hands” means without man's hands. “the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.” Christ is coming to destroy these empires.

And where does the stone hit? It “smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.” That is Edom's Achilles heel. It is the promise from the beginning: “it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.” The feet are the last empire, America and NATO from 1776 until today. When the stone strikes there, “the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold” are broken to pieces together and become “like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them”.

“and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.” That great mountain is God's kingdom being established, the kingdom that “shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people”. Other races will be there, but they won't be ruling a thing. We are living in the days of these kings, and what you see here is the beginning of God's kingdom. You might kill millions of us, but this truth is going to continue, because the King it is built on is the chief corner stone.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:9
precepts.why:

These kings are all the kingdoms that ruled on this planet, the great image of Nebuchadnezzar's dream: Babylon the head of gold, then Persia, then Greece, then Rome, and America comes up last. We are in the last part of this beast right now, in America. All the other kingdoms were destroyed, and these are going to be destroyed.

Daniel brings the same kingdoms out again in the seventh chapter with his dream: “I beheld till the thrones were cast down”. Until the rulerships were destroyed. Daniel looked and saw these four great kings destroyed, and then the Most High sat down, opened the books and judged them. That is how it goes.

“and the Ancient of days did sit”. The Ancient of days means he was here before days began; that is the Most High, and his judgment sat. Did sit: that tells you something. He had a body in order to sit. He had legs, he had a garment on, he sat down, and he had hair on his head. People say God doesn't have a body; he has a celestial body. I know the Most High is the Most High, but he had a form so we could describe him. He didn't say he was a lizard or some other creature; he sat down and judged, so he looked like a man type of figure, the way the Lord is called a man of war.

“whose garment was white as snow”: he wasn't like a ghost or a sheet flying in the wind; the garment was on his body. “and the hair of his head like the pure wool”: like pure negro hair, white and woolly, black men's hair. So in the days of these kings, while they are in rulership and the decadence is setting in, the Most High is causing us to get ourselves together, and persecution is part of that. When the thrones are cast down and the Ancient of days sits in judgment, the God of heaven sets up the kingdom that “shall not be left to other people”, other races and nations, but is for the twelve tribes of Israel, and it “shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”. That is what Christ is going to do.

precepts.label: Daniel 3:1-6
precepts.why:
Nebuchadnezzar is the head of gold in Daniel's dream, and before God humbled him in chapter 4, his pride is shown in chapter 3: “Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.” In his pride he set up a golden image and said everybody should worship it.

He gathered the princes, the governors, the captains, the judges and all the rulers of the provinces to its dedication, and “an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages”, that when they heard the music they should “fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up”. And “whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.”

That is the same thing America does now with the flag. You don't bow down to it; now you have to stand up and salute it and honor it. It is the same as it was in ancient Babylon, just a different way.

This is why the decree of Daniel 4 came upon him. Nebuchadnezzar got prideful, and pride brings a man low. Twelve months after Daniel's interpretation he said, “Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?” God calls America Babylon the great, and Nebuchadnezzar called Babylon great himself. “While the word was in the king’s mouth”, the kingdom departed from him. You try to make people worship you, and it is taken.

He was made to eat grass as oxen “until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. Until you humble yourself, you are eating grass. And he did humble himself; he came back and confessed there is no God like the God of Daniel. All kingdoms fall because of pride, Assyria, Babylon, the Greeks, Rome and America, and nobody is exempt from God's judgment for it.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:14
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear”, and the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up, because through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier than Media. “and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. What three nations do those ribs represent? Isaiah 45:14 answers: “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia conquered.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. Isaiah says of him, “He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” And the chapter of the three ribs opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”.

So the Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to let us go back and build the temple, and gave him Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans to devour. That is why the bear rose up on one side, and why the land of Persia, Iran, stands in prophecy for the days we are in.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:14
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. The bear is Persia and Media, a dual empire, and it raised itself up on one side because Persia rose up greater than the Medes. To explain the three ribs, go to Isaiah 45.

It opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”. God chose Cyrus the Persian to release the Israelites. And what did Persia receive? “The labour of Egypt”: that is one rib. “and merchandise of Ethiopia”: that is the second. “and of the Sabeans”: that is Somalia, the third. “men of stature”, tall men, “shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee”.

So when the Most High told Cyrus to release his people from captivity, he promised to make him ruler over many nations, and these three are the ribs between the bear's teeth. “and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh”: that means conquer. The Scripture explains the Scripture; the ribs are not a mystery once you lay the precept beside the vision.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 12:10-11
precepts.why:
Daniel gives an animal for each of the first three kingdoms: the lion for Babylon, the bear for Persia and Media, the leopard for the Greeks. But for the fourth beast, “dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly”, with “great iron teeth”, no animal is named. You have to go to 2 Esdras 12.

“This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.” The animal symbol Daniel was not shown is the eagle, and it was only revealed to Esdras. That is why it is precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little. If you don't read the Bible that way, you are going to be confused.

So the fourth beast is Rome, the eagle. It “devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it”: when you stomp on somebody so hard you can see the bootprint on his face. What did they stamp on us? Their philosophies and their doctrines. That is why we wholeheartedly believe Sunday and their days of the week, and all the foolishness the white man has told us. Its ten horns are the same ten horns of Revelation, what we call NATO today.

Esau knows the fourth one is the eagle. That is why the pictures they put out get the first three right and make up some creature for the last, to throw off the so-called black Christians, who sit in the churches saying nobody knows who the fourth kingdom is. The precept in Esdras settles it.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:25
precepts.why:
The little horn that came up among the ten is America, which came out of Britain, and it had “a mouth speaking great things.” Verse 25 is still speaking of this same beast and shows what that mouth does: “And he shall speak great words against the most High”. They blasphemed the Lord. They said, if there is a God, he is a white man.

“and shall wear out the saints of the most High”: they wore us out in slavery.

“and think to change times and laws”. Changing times is daylight saving time, and a year that begins in the dead of winter. Changing laws is same-sex laws, you can marry, if it feels good, do it; and the Sabbath moved from the seventh day to the first day of the week. They changed the laws of God.

“and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” The Israelites are given into this man's hands. A time is one, times is two, and the dividing of time makes three and a half.

And the fight against this beast is not a physical one: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” The rulers of the darkness are their governments, with America at the top of the pinnacle, followed by Britain, France and Germany. There are people behind the scenes, the deep state, the CIA, the FBI and the military officials, telling the president what to do. Republicans and Democrats are two horns on the same beast; it is good cop, bad cop, and the agenda is the same.

precepts.label: Revelation 12:12
precepts.why:

“Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” The heavens are the sovereign countries, the sovereign nations: America, the free world, and France, Germany and Britain. Those that dwell in them are their people. “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth”: that is the other nations. “and of the sea”: the islands, like Jamaica and Haiti. “for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.”

How does he know his time is short? He is examining the scriptures and examining the twelve tribes of Israel, their level of engagement and understanding. They base their time on us. The churches are not bringing out the transgressions of this system; church makes you think things are paradise. We are the ones bringing out the transgressions, so we are the ones measuring when the transgressors are come to the full, and they have their eyes here. That is why YouTube, after shutting down every Israelite video for a year, let the Israelites back on: without us they were running blind in the dark.

And he comes down with great wrath. You see what Israel is doing to the Palestinians, and what America under Trump has ICE doing. It is going to get worse; the party isn't over. You can play games all you want, but the rest of us, prepare yourselves.

A spirit told him to put that gunpowder in a metal casing, strike it with a spark, and shoot a piece of metal at his enemies at a distance. A spirit showed him how to build a propulsion unit to go to the moon, and a suit to breathe up there, without his ever having been there. People ask, how did the white man figure all this stuff out? Satan. The dragon gave him his power.

So “he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” The holy people are us. You are seeing an inkling of it now, but it is only going to escalate; they have not finished with the twelve tribes yet. His might is borrowed from Satan, and that is why, when the Prince of princes stands against him, “he shall be broken without hand.”

“and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The dragon, which is Satan, gave him his power. That is Daniel's king whose “power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”.

A lot of people think the white man was just so smart that he figured things out on his own. No, there are spirits he works with. The series Strange Angel tells how he basically encountered the devil and figured out rocket science. That is how they got into space: the dragon gave him his power.

So Daniel's king “shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise”, and “by peace shall destroy many”. Today Trump has the Board of Peace, and everybody says how great it is; no, they are destroying nations. But he stands up against the Prince of princes, Christ, and he “shall be broken without hand”: Christ is going to destroy him.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:6
precepts.why:
“After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.” This leopard represents the Greeks. The four wings of a fowl are four major militaries. The four heads are the four major generals: Ptolemy took over Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Lysimachus Thrace, and Cassander Macedonia.

That is why Daniel 8:23 says “in the latter time of their kingdom”: it is the kingdom of Grecia carried on into the last days. When Revelation 13:2 says the beast was “like unto a leopard”, it is like the Greek Empire. It is not the actual Greek Empire, but it has elements of it.

The rest of the beast is read the same way from Daniel 7: “his feet were as the feet of a bear” is the Persians and Medes, whose symbol that was, and “his mouth as the mouth of a lion” is Babylon. So the king of fierce countenance who stands up in the latter time carries the marks of all these kingdoms, with the dragon's power behind him.

precepts.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:4
precepts.why:
The same thing Daniel wrote in chapter 11, verses 36 to 39, is recorded in 2 Thessalonians 2:4: “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”. To oppose means you go against. Daniel said the king would “exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god”; the Greeks did this, Rome did this, and America has done the same thing.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: his temples are the temples of God. “shewing himself that he is God”: all his images show him as God, as the Son of God, as the angels, as the Jews. What we read in 2 Thessalonians 2 is the same thing Daniel prophesied the white man would do.

In the Pillory, the tale of the Borgia pope, explains it: it is an open secret that Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, posed for the new image of Jesus, with the crown of thorns and the thin hair; Salvator means Saviour. That is the strange god Daniel spoke of, “a god whom his fathers knew not”, which “he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”.

Paul warned of it: “For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”. This is another Jesus; you won't find a scripture describing Jesus like this. And what comes with another Jesus is another spirit, an antichrist spirit, and another gospel. Black Christians love to say it doesn't matter what he looks like, only his message; but a gospel where all races come together in the name of white Jesus, the apostles never taught or accepted. That ain't in the Bible.

He has fooled the world into thinking he serves the God of the Bible, but he does not. He honours “the God of forces”, the god of weaponry and destruction, he causes his lieutenants and generals “to rule over many”, and he divides “the land for gain”, as Alexander's four generals did, and as Europe divided up Africa at the Berlin Conference.

precepts.label: 1 Kings 8:47
precepts.why:
Hosea says the children of Israel shall be “as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered”: dispersed, so that we could be preserved. And “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” We are hearing that now and seeing it now. Our teachers tell us these things, we identify with them, and that is how we regain our identity.

Solomon’s prayer shows the steps: “Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness”.

First we have to bethink ourselves: remember ourselves and reclaim our identity, right here in the land of our captivity. That is part of the strangeness of our salvation. Then we repent and make supplication, and then God will acknowledge us, be for us and fight for us.

This is not a time of peace but a time of war. Not physical war: there is nothing we can do against these powers and nations physically. What we can do is unite as a people, come back together, keep God’s laws in solidarity, and wait on our Redeemer. In the place where we were called not his people, we remember who we are, we repent, and we are called the sons of the living God.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 1:21
precepts.why:
How do we bring about that change? How do you fight a nuke? How do you fight powers that can turn off your lights, run your economy and take your resources right under your nose while you say thank you? With something small and simple: “For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.”

It was God’s wisdom that the world would not know him, that they would purposely not be able to understand. It is given unto us to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God; he made everything a mystery so that only his elect can unseal what the Bible says. And just as it pleases him to see a man lifted up in power so that he can take him down, it pleases him to save by the foolishness of preaching. That is how we get our identity back. That is how we come back.

So look at the brothers in the streets. Don’t think those efforts are small; they are making an impact. Even if your camp doesn’t have a lot of foot traffic, none of it is in vain, none of it is void. You go out, you preach, you gather, you fish. Even if there are scarce fish in that water, if you know there is a spot where fish be, you stay there until you catch at least one. You are not trying to come home empty.

It starts with preaching and then it escalates. First we repent, then we get the honor. We do not fight physically now: we repent now, we fight through preaching, and God fights for us later. Then comes the honor of Psalm 149, “a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen”, for “this honour have all his saints.” When he shall roar, “the children shall tremble from the west”, the western hemisphere, “and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord”: our tribes, our royal heritage and our identity given back to us, the sons of the living God.

precepts.label: Micah 2:10
precepts.why:
“in their affliction they will seek me early.” Why do we have to get deported? So that we seek God early. A lot of our people think this is the American dream, this is what life is about: get a house, get a car, barbecue on the weekend, watch sports, send your kids to college. No, that is Esau's way of life. This is death, this is oppression, and the Most High has to afflict us to remind us that this is not our rest.

Micah says it: “Arise ye, and depart”. Separate yourself from these heathen nations, these strangers, the real aliens. “for this is not your rest”. You were not brought here on slave ships to be comfortable, to assimilate, or to be friends with these heathen nations. You see the betrayal time and time again when you make a league with the strangers. “Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest”: we work and we have to watch our backs for ICE agents who come to our places of business and our homes, arrest us and kidnap our children.

“because it is polluted”: wicked, evil, deceptive. Witchcraft is in this place, so bad that it has you bleaching your skin, blonding your hair, putting in contacts, starving yourself. “it shall destroy you”: it destroyed Sammy Sosa, Serena Williams, Lil' Kim. Those are the celebrities Esau upholds so our people look up to them and want to be like them. It is witchcraft to make a black man hate himself so much that he destroys his own face.

“even with a sore destruction.” Destruction is coming to this place; this kingdom is not going to last forever. We are in the last days, so we have to get our minds right and our spirits right. There is much work to be done, especially for you so-called Latinos: Judah has shown us the way, and now it is our turn. When you see a head of state like Nicolás Maduro kidnapped and his country's resources stolen, that is for you to wake up. Seek his face, and see in the scriptures that he looks just like us.

precepts.label: Hosea 9:13-14
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown. We still have that, but you have a lot of light skin, and it was strategic. The whitening campaigns across Latin America were a war on blackness, meant to make us forget our heritage: grandmothers praising good hair and light babies, textbooks erasing black heroes, children taught not to embrace their nose, their lips or their skin. That is how you colonize a people from the inside out. This devil is very evil and very strategic, but there is a God.

“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The pleasant place is the island of Puerto Rico. Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph. “Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.”

A lot of misinformed and uneducated people think the northern kingdom is not Israel just because they are light-skinned. No. The Lord knows exactly who they are, and the Lord made sure the seed would continue. It doesn't matter if they are light or dark; the Lord knows who is who, just as he knew that Asher would land in Brazil, and Brazil is Hebrew for iron. The Lord didn't make a mistake.

So the cake not turned is still Ephraim. Mixed among the people and whitened on top, brought forth to the murderer in a pleasant place, the northern kingdom is still the children of Israel, and the curses on them prove it.

precepts.label: 1 Esdras 8:69
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people”, sometimes willingly, sometimes not. You have knuckleheads who say that is only talking about their customs. It was biological and it was symbolic, dummy. The Bible defines the Bible, and Ezra shows what mixing means: “The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles.”

We did not put away the strange people from the land. We sought after them, because of the ideology of whitening, of bettering the race. The pollutions of the Gentiles are their idolatry and their doctrines, and we became corrupt in our merchandise and commerce. All Israel had that propensity, but here the focus is the northern kingdom.

Read on: “For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land.” When it says mixed himself among the people, it means the seed gets mixed. What is the seed? Sperm, semen. So when somebody comes to you with that BS, this is the scripture to put there: mixing means mixing.

It goes on: “and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.” All of us partook of that, and it is a sin to mix with the other nations. That is why Ephraim is a cake not turned: light on one side and dark on the other, all the different shades among the northern kingdom, and some of our own people with blonde hair and blue eyes whose father is Israel.

precepts.label: Psalms 106:35
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people.” Ezra already showed that the holy seed was mixed with the strange people of the land. David gives the other side of it: “But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.” It was not just ideological, dummies, and some of the ones saying it went to seminary school and call themselves theologians. When you look up the definition of mingled, it goes into mixing, just like First Esdras. And they learned their works too.

So Hosea is talking about ideology, and it is also talking about the seed, like we just proved. Scholars know the whitening was both ideological and biological. “Ephraim is a cake not turned. Strangers have devoured his strength.” The cake not turned is the colours, light and dark: some of us light, some in between, some dark.

The strangers devoured more than the strength of the royal seed. Our strength lies in the Lord, the joy of the Lord is our strength, and the ideology cut us away from him. We cannot fight the United States; our countries cannot do any of that. It is time we come back to God. Strangers devoured his strength, “and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.” Many of our older people are not hearing it; the gray hairs are upon them and they cannot accept it.

And this goes with Matthew 13 and Amos 9, especially for you northern kingdom brothers. Southern kingdom, learn northern kingdom history with the same vigour and zeal that we learn yours. If you are a fisher of men, you fish all the different kinds of fish that pertain to Israel and Christ.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 12:9
precepts.why:
Ephraim mixed himself among the people and became “a cake not turned”, light and dark. Jeremiah shows how the Lord sees that mixed people: “Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.”

We are a speckled bird, and the birds round about against her are the enemy. They know who we are because of the caste system. Though we are mixed, they know who we are. In Panama they call the light-skinned ones one name and the darker ones, some of whom are Benjamin, another, and the lady at the hotel sized each of us up by our shade the same way.

But the Lord had a way to fix that, because the Israelite seed is that strong: go back to the Israelite line, and it does not matter how mixed the daughter was. And Hosea says Ephraim would “bring forth his children to the murderer”: Cain, Esau, Edom, the Spaniards, the United States. For those who willingly tried to whiten the race: “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of those babies died.

So the speckled bird is still his heritage. “How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” Though he struck us with these curses, he will not make us as Admah and Zeboim, the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort, and let God do the separating.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:45
precepts.why:
Ephraim was “planted in a pleasant place”, the blessings, but “Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The murderer is Cain, Esau, Edom: the Spaniards, the United States. That was the whitening, el blanqueamiento, sometimes done willingly and sometimes not. So God said “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of the babies of those who tried to whiten us out died, and what is left behind is largely not European; many who look European there came over later. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort as Christ taught, and let God do the separating.

How could a people fall so low, go through so much, and still rise and reconnect to their identity? People are baffled by it; to them it is ignorant and even offensive for us to know who we are. Deuteronomy 28:45 answers it: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.” And “they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.”

Those curses became our identity, and our redemption. They are the way we acknowledge who we are and make our way back. If not these curses, then who is it? The Bible always said Israel would come back to its identity, and now that we are back, the world is bugging out. Where are the lost tribes? They are here now.

It is God's grand plan. If we were all together in one spot, they could have wiped us out. By dispersing us into the four corners of the earth he also preserved us, like the worm in the movie Swordfish, broken up and scattered to the four corners of the internet so no one could get it back without the one who hid it. What was our curse, God meant for good, so that now we can come back together. As Hosea said, the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, and “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

precepts.label: Zechariah 9:13
precepts.why:
“How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” God is saying, how am I going to turn away from you, my son, and deliver you forever to the heathen? Admah and Zeboim were the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed, and he cannot do that to us. Though he strikes us with righteous judgment in these curses, he has not forgotten us. “I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger”: all the horror of these curses we deal with is mercy.

What comes after the repentance is the honor, and Zechariah shows it: “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”, that is, repent, and “even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”. Then: “When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.”

This is talking about a weapon. Judah is bent first, like the bow, and then he fills the bow with Ephraim, like an arrow. It is the same order as Hosea 11:10: he roars like a lion because the tents of Judah are raised first, and the northern kingdom sees that example and follows it, and the children tremble from the west, from the western hemisphere. Thy sons, O Greece, goes into Edom, Esau, Cain, all these countries that rule with a fist of iron.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning”. That arrow is us. Christ leads the charge, and we get to move like that too, with the two-edged sword in our hand to execute vengeance upon the heathen, the honor all his saints have. “they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar”: we partake in the vengeance, like the blood of the sacrifice filling the bowls thrown on the altar. We don't just stand by and watch it.

So we don't fight physically now; we repent now and fight through preaching, and God fights for us later. He will place us in our houses, tell us, you're from Asher, you're from Ephraim, from Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, Naphtali, and give us back our royal heritage and our identity.

precepts.label: Isaiah 43:5
precepts.why:
Hosea says the Lord “shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.” The west is the western hemisphere, where the tribes are primarily scattered.

Isaiah says the same: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west”. The Lord gathers his children from where they are, and the west is where most of them are, here in America and this side of the world.

So when the Lord roars, the children who tremble and walk after him come from the west, and he gathers them. That is the hope for the tribes over here, but it comes with a warning. Before this the class read that Babylon's “sins have reached unto heaven”, and that we must come out of the ways of America and out of her idolatry. If we don't repent of our stubbornness, our bullheadedness and our idolatry, we will get the same judgment as her. The seed that is gathered from the west is the seed that answers the roar and walks after the Lord.

precepts.label: Zechariah 8:7-8
precepts.why:
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country”. The children who tremble from the west in Hosea are the ones the Lord saves from the west country. “And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Remember what the Jewish Encyclopedia said earlier in the class about Arzareth: the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel would dwell observing the laws of Moses until the time of the restoration, and Columbus identified America with that land. It was prophesied that we would be over here until the time of restoration. This is that restoration: the Lord bringing us from the west country to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem.

And it is “in truth and in righteousness”. That is why the class closed on idolatry: “the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil”, and our stubbornness and disdain for God's commandments are idolatry. Flee from idolatry, so that you are among the people he brings back.

precepts.label: Isaiah 14:16
precepts.why:
Obadiah says, “Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord”. Part of that rumour is: who is Esau? Once the world finds out who Esau really is, it is over. Isaiah shows the moment: “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”.

Is this the man? That is a statement of total astonishment. You mean to tell me we have been on this earth all this time and you are the Edomite this Bible is talking about? You are the devil this Bible speaks of? People are going to be completely blown away and shocked, because the secrets have been revealed and the truth has come out. What did they tell me in church? What did they tell me in school, on TV? All of these lies. You mean to tell me this man is the devil?

The only reason they will know it is because we are bringing it out. The prophets are bringing it out. When we teach it, people hear it and understand it and start to realise, wait a minute, the white man is the devil. And they know it themselves. Trump already knows it: we know we are the devil, we are going to hang on as long as we can, get rid of everybody and rule, and we don't care about being nice. You don't have to apologise any more. Embrace your whiteness. Yes, we are Satan, and we are going to be Satan. They say embrace it, because it is coming out now.

So their mission is to stop the teaching, because if they can stop it they can rule a little longer. The more we bring out prophecies and show the world who this man really is, the worse it gets, and that is where the persecution comes from. That is why the black preachers are going crazy now: the Tatumites, Tatum, Pam, all them dudes, paid and given big churches, sent to make sure the Israelites do not wake up.

precepts.label: Luke 4:5-7
precepts.why:
Obadiah speaks “concerning Edom”: the white man, the Caucasian, by his biblical name. “Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars”. They were so proud that they went to the moon and claimed it for their own, something they did not even create. They do not let other nations plant a flag there; they said, the Eagle has landed. And now one of their government says, we own the moon, why not Greenland? That is pride.

There is a reason behind it, and Luke shows it: “the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it. If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.”

This Edomite is prideful because he has the spiritual power of Satan rolling with him. That is who gave him the power to go to the moon and to make these weapons to destroy all of mankind. No brown nation on the earth came up with the invention to destroy everybody; that belongs solely to the white man, because Satan is behind him. That is who he made a covenant with, not the God of the Bible.

So when you see In God we trust on the money, know he is not talking about anybody in this Bible. The Psalm proves it: “The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.” “The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor”, and you judge whether a man is prideful or humble by how he treats the lowly: the blacks, Hispanics and Native Indians, who have no army. Out of all the kingdoms, Assyrian, Babylonian, Persian, Greek, Roman, none has been more prideful than Esau.

But the kingdoms Satan gives are not the Lord's, and Obadiah answers the pride: “thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” From the moment they said the Eagle has landed, they have been going down, because that is when the Israelites started hitting the streets with the word of God. The more we are gathered together, the more Esau comes down.

But it is temporary. Waiting generation after generation for his judgment, the pride of his heart has deceived him. He forgot what his judgment is and thinks he is untouchable, especially after seeing what his weapons did to the air defences of Russia and China.

Now Trump is talking like that. On Air Force One after capturing Maduro he names the countries he will come after: Colombia, run by a sick man; Mexico, where the cartels are running things. David shows where that ends: “Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” You reap what you sow. What he puts out is the exact same way his demise is going to come.

That is the lineage of Cain: Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”, and where others saw tools his mind saw weapons. precepts.label: 1 Esdras 4:45
precepts.why:
Obadiah is “concerning Edom”: the whole chapter is about Edom and what they did. “In the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.” Even Edom was as one of them. First Esdras names the deed plainly: “Thou also hast vowed to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees.”

So who burned the temple? The Edomites. The history agrees: when the first temple was destroyed in 586 BC, Edom aided the Babylonian Empire rather than helping Judah, their brother. They rejoiced, looted the city, blocked the survivors fleeing, and took part in razing Solomon's temple. The brother of the Israelites assisted the Babylonians, which were Cushites, in destroying the first temple.

That is every charge in Obadiah. “Thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger”: the twelve tribes did become strangers. “Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction”: they rejoiced when we got destroyed. They “laid hands on their substance”: they were robbing us too. They “stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape”: when we were escaping, Edom blocked our way, held us in, and gave us up to the Babylonians.

That is why the Psalm cries, “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Rase it: destroy it. That is what Edom did when they burned down that temple, and it is why Edom is called the daughter of Babylon, because they assisted the Cushite Babylonians: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”.

precepts.label: Acts 13:1
precepts.why:
“Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger”. Right there among the prophets and teachers of the church is a man called Niger. It was never derogatory. It was a name for our people, used in the church itself, set alongside Barnabas, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen and Saul.

That is the same thing as Micah the Morasthite in Micah 1:1. The word Moor is in the Bible: Micah, teacher of the Moors. These names were ours, and they described our people plainly. The names that came later were put on us by others: the Latins, who later became the Romans, gave the name Africa to the region around Carthage and Utica. Africa was a term that came way later.

So we have to go back to the name God calls us. Simeon called Niger and Micah the Morasthite were Israelites, teachers and prophets of our people, and the scriptures show them to us by those names without any shame in them.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 26:18
precepts.why:
Jeremiah names the same prophet: “Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.”

It confirms Micah 1:1: the word of the Lord came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and it was a word against Jerusalem. Morasthite: the Moor is in the Bible, and Micah was a teacher of the Moors.

And what Micah prophesied is what happened to us, over and over. Anytime we are set somewhere, we rise up as a nation, and the Lord allows Esau to conquer us. Why? Because the savior is Christ. If we could do it without Christ, why would we need Christ? The Moors went into Europe in 710 AD and brought universities, soap, the holy waters that became rubbing alcohol, strawberries, olives and grapes, wine, even chess; then they were conquered and scattered, many sent to Africa and transported to Brazil and North America. Zion plowed like a field, Jerusalem become heaps.

precepts.label: 2 Chronicles 3:1
precepts.why:
This shows that the hill of the Morasthites was part of Jerusalem: “Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.” Moriah: Moor right there, black again.

The reference work read in class says the same. Moriah was a hill adjacent to Jerusalem, on the northeast. There Abraham offered his son, in Genesis 22, and when Solomon built the temple on it, it became included in the city.

So the temple of the Lord stood on the hill of the Moors, and Micah the Morasthite, the teacher of the Moors, was a prophet of that same people. The Moors were Israelites; the names Moors and Africa came later, but the land and the house of the Lord tie them to Jerusalem.

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 12:10-11
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says, “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. Something is wrong with that man; he is not normal. Wisdom of Solomon shows Esau: “But executing thy judgments upon them by little and little, thou gavest them place of repentance”. By little and little: a war here, a war there, a storm here, a tsunami there, a plague here, a plague there.

“Not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.” A naughty generation, like the border of wickedness. Their hatred was bred in them: when God created them, a couple of drops of hatred, put in the oven and baked, and you cannot get it out of the dough. Their cogitation, their way of thinking, their mind frame, will never change. The Lord created him that way.

Sometimes they do things they don't even know why they do. In Florida a man caring for handicapped kids lay flat on the ground with his hands up, and the cop shot him; asked why, the cop said, I don't know. In the South bodies are found hanging and the judgment is suicide, as if our brothers had superpowers to tie their own hands behind their backs and dunk their necks into the noose.

“For it was a cursed seed from the beginning”. Not a blessed seed: Cain was cursed from the beginning, and he came back as Esau, cursed from the beginning. “Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned.” They cannot be pardoned. Their malice is bred in them, they are cursed from the beginning, their cogitation will never change, and no matter what they do they can never be pardoned for the sins they have committed. Your pastor done lied to you.

precepts.label: Micah 2:11
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says of the proud man, “because he transgresseth by wine”. What is the wine he transgresses by? Micah gives the precept: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.”

The wine is the falsehood and the lying. Esau is a liar. He gave you Protestant: lies. Mormon: lies. Seventh-day Adventists, Jehovah's Witnesses, Pentecostal: lies. Freemasonry, Rosicrucian, Thelema: lies. Every institute of doctrine he put on this earth for you to follow and worship is a lie, and all they do is take you away from God.

That wine is how he rules. He “neither keepeth at home”: the US controls about 850 military bases in more than 90 countries, and there are more churches than military bases. The real way to control us is through Christianity, because we are more obedient to Christianity than to his military. And the church convinces you it is okay to be broke, okay to be poor and hurt, okay for your country to lie desolate while another man eats your riches: just pray to Jesus and you will be all right.

No, it is not okay. The earth belongs to us and it is going to come back to us. The just shall live by his faith, not by the wine of the prophet of lies.
